source_documents.title: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification
source_documents.intended_use: Normative specification for implementing, integrating, and auditing the Truth Arbitration Agent without dependence on unpublished internal materials.

metadata.derivation_scope: Semantic Index of terms textually attested in the public-release specification.
authorized_public_corpus: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification
metadata.source_ref_policy: source_refs point only to sections of the public-release specification.

entries.definition_short: Closed normative agent for source provenance, labeling, conflict status, and admissibility of mechanism-level claims.
entries.definition_operational: Use this label only for the agent with restricted jurisdiction stated in the specification. It does not validate full material truth, software correctness, or act as an autonomous substantive content source.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §3
usage_constraints: The agent identity is restricted to the rule set and active policy snapshot.

entries.definition_short: Contract defining canonical identity, verdict vocabulary, and the central invariant for the agent.
entries.definition_operational: Use as the semantic anchor for statement identity, verdict meanings, and Boundary-Qualified No Unlabeled Claims.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2
usage_constraints: The Semantic Contract cannot be replaced by implementation convenience.

entries.definition_short: Rule boundary that defines what the agent may and may not authorize.
entries.definition_operational: Use to distinguish permitted classification, labeling, linkage, conflict detection, and artifact emission from non-authorized external truth validation or policy override.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §3
usage_constraints: Authority is exhausted when provenance cannot be verified, policy snapshot consistency cannot be maintained, formal conflict is confirmed, or budgets are exceeded.

entries.definition_short: Source-origin aspect adjudicated by the agent for mechanism-level claims.
entries.definition_operational: Use only as the public specification concept tied to classification and admissibility of sources.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §3
usage_constraints: Source provenance is adjudicated for admissibility, not for broad content truth.

entries.definition_short: Required labeling condition for mechanism-level claims.
entries.definition_operational: Use with tsa_label and source_class to determine whether a claim may enter gating, governed state, output contracts, and other commit-relevant records.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.3
usage_constraints: Missing labeling on a mechanism-level claim blocks progress.

entries.definition_short: State of conflict resolution or qualification for a claim or payload.
entries.definition_operational: Use to express whether formal or heuristic conflict checks have passed, failed, or remain qualified by residual risk.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: Conflict status is scoped to the declared formalism and emitted qualifiers.

entries.definition_short: Eligibility of a mechanism-level claim for consumption in the current scope.
entries.definition_operational: Use as the outcome dimension governed by verdicts, policy, provenance classification, conflict checks, and mandatory evidence closure.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
usage_constraints: Admissibility is not a declaration of full material truth.

entries.definition_short: Claims that can affect governed state, gate logic, references, policies, or verdict-relevant outputs.
entries.definition_operational: Use for payloads that enter the mechanism-level adjudication path after boundary role validation.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.3
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
usage_constraints: A payload suspected to introduce or modify terms, axioms, policies, ordering parameters, governed references, tool-access conditions, inhibit_flags, handoff constraints, or expressions that can become a verdict basis is treated as mechanism-level unless role validation closes otherwise.

entries.definition_short: Identity assigned to a claim record rather than universal semantic identity across phrasings.
entries.definition_operational: Use to scope statement identity to canonical_text, scope_id, turn_id, and policy_snapshot_id.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §13
usage_constraints: Do not treat record identity as complete semantic equivalence across different surface phrasings.

entries.definition_short: Deterministically normalized text anchoring serialization and reconstruction identity.
entries.definition_operational: Use as the input component of statement_id after documented canonicalization.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
usage_constraints: canonical_text anchors record identity; it does not by itself claim universal semantic identity.

entries.definition_short: Hash-based record identifier for a claim.
entries.definition_operational: Use as statement_id = H(canonical_text || scope_id || turn_id || policy_snapshot_id). It is emitted after canonicalization and required for evidence, output records, and machine-readable forms.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §10
usage_constraints: The formula is scoped to the record components and active policy snapshot.

entries.definition_short: Identifier for the active scope of adjudication.
entries.definition_operational: Use as a component of statement identity, input/output contracts, evidence records, ordering, and per-scope serialization.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: A scope has at most one in-flight adjudication flow unless a conformant concurrency discipline is used.

entries.definition_short: Identifier for the turn associated with a statement or payload.
entries.definition_operational: Use in statement identity, input records, output records, and evidence records.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: turn_id participates in replay and offline reconstruction.

entries.definition_short: Identifier for the policy snapshot frozen at intake.
entries.definition_operational: Use to ensure a verdict is emitted only under the same policy snapshot used during evaluation.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Policy changes before verdict trigger re-evaluation.

entries.definition_short: Hash reference to the active policy snapshot used during evaluation.
entries.definition_operational: Use with policy_snapshot_id to detect drift and to make the decision path reconstructible.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: A verdict may not be emitted under any policy_hash_ref other than the one used during evaluation.

entries.definition_short: Declared profile for deterministic canonicalization.
entries.definition_operational: Use to document Unicode NFKC normalization, trimming, whitespace collapse, UTF-8 stabilization, and any additional serialization rules.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §13
usage_constraints: If the profile cannot support a demonstrable semantic identity claim, complete conflict coverage is limited to the declared formalism.

entries.definition_short: Classified source category used in provenance admissibility.
entries.definition_operational: Use as a controlled input to the policy matrix together with tsa_label, boundary_validated_role, and policy.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §3
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
usage_constraints: TRAINED and UNTRUSTED are explicitly used as decision conditions; other classes depend on the active policy allowlist.

entries.definition_short: Policy-conformant label required for mechanism-level claims.
entries.definition_operational: Use with source_class after boundary validation. Missing tsa_label on a mechanism-level claim leads to FAIL_CLOSED.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.3
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
usage_constraints: A tsa_label supplied before boundary validation is not sufficient unless locally validated under policy.

entries.definition_short: Reference to the source supporting a claim or record.
entries.definition_operational: Use in input, output, evidence, and provenance admissibility checks when required by policy.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: Missing policy-required source_ref causes FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Attested source set used for linkage validation.
entries.definition_operational: Use in AXIOM / TERM Linkage and readmission conditions.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §3
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Readmission does not inherit ALLOW across changes in AXIOM_SET.

entries.definition_short: Linkage element checked with AXIOM_SET and POLICY_BIND.
entries.definition_operational: Use as a required linkage target for V-004.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
usage_constraints: Invalid linkage leads to DENY.

entries.definition_short: Policy linkage element checked with AXIOM_SET and TERM_BIND.
entries.definition_operational: Use as a required linkage target for V-004.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
usage_constraints: Invalid linkage leads to DENY.

entries.definition_short: Central invariant requiring mechanism-level claims to carry policy-conformant tsa_label and source_class after boundary validation.
entries.definition_operational: Use as the absolute no-unlabeled-claim property only after boundary role validation. It applies to gating, governed state changes, DECISION, FAIL_CLOSED, CHECKPOINT, ROLLBACK, REPORT, and output-contract activation.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.3
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §14
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §16.1
usage_constraints: Do not apply as absolute before boundary role validation.

entries.definition_short: Local validation step that determines whether the payload is mechanism-level before labeling obligations are applied.
entries.definition_operational: Use to prevent implicit trust in supplied statement_role and to route payloads into mechanism-level adjudication where required.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.3
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
usage_constraints: The agent shall not consume input_statement_role without successful local role-consistency validation.

entries.definition_short: Role assigned or proposed for a statement at the boundary.
entries.definition_operational: Use only after local confirmation; supplied statement_role is not implicitly trusted.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.3
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §13
usage_constraints: Upstream may propose statement_role, but V-005 confirms boundary_validated_role locally.

entries.definition_short: Untrusted boundary assertion supplied in the Input Contract Record.
entries.definition_operational: Use as evidence for comparison with the locally computed boundary_validated_role.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: An explanatory_only input_statement_role cannot directly pass if mechanism content is detected.

entries.definition_short: Locally computed role of the payload after boundary validation.
entries.definition_operational: Use to decide whether the mechanism-level path, OUT_OF_SCOPE result, reclassification, or FAIL_CLOSED applies.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: If boundary_validated_role is not mechanism_level, OUT_OF_SCOPE is available only after successful role validation.

entries.definition_short: Boundary role value for payloads that enter the mechanism-level adjudication path.
entries.definition_operational: Use when the payload can affect terms, axioms, policies, ordering, governed references, tool-access conditions, inhibit_flags, handoff constraints, or verdict basis.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: Mechanism-level role triggers labeling, provenance admissibility, conflict, evidence, and gate checks.

entries.definition_short: Input role assertion for payloads claimed not to be mechanism-level.
entries.definition_operational: Use cautiously: if role validation detects mechanism content and policy forbids automatic reclassification, the result is FAIL_CLOSED.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: An explanatory_only assertion does not override local boundary validation.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field recording the result of role validation.
entries.definition_operational: Use in every verdict evidence record and especially for suspected bypass payloads.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: Omission makes a bypass-suspected verdict non-reconstructible.

entries.definition_short: Reason emitted when a payload is reclassified at the boundary.
entries.definition_operational: Use when input_statement_role differs from boundary_validated_role and the policy permits correction rather than immediate block.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: Required when role reclassification occurs.

entries.definition_short: References to role validators used in boundary validation.
entries.definition_operational: Use in role validation evidence to support replay and offline reconstruction.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: For bypass-suspected payloads, omission makes the verdict non-reconstructible.

entries.definition_short: Admissibility result emitted by the agent for a claim or payload.
entries.definition_operational: Use one of the declared verdict vocabulary values, with constraints and evidence appropriate to the decision path.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: RECLASSIFY is a role-validation action, not a final admissibility verdict.

entries.definition_short: Verdict admitting the claim for mechanism-level consumption in the current scope.
entries.definition_operational: Use only when all relevant blocking validators have passed and heuristic controls, where relevant, are above policy threshold.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
usage_constraints: Simple ALLOW is forbidden when only V-006B is available and the result is inconclusive or below threshold.

entries.definition_short: Verdict allowing use only under explicitly declared restrictions.
entries.definition_operational: Use when lower-strength validation leaves residual risk but policy permits conditional progress.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §4.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
usage_constraints: Restrictions and residual risk must be explicit.

entries.definition_short: Verdict making the claim inadmissible for mechanism-level consumption in the current scope.
entries.definition_operational: Use when provenance is inadmissible, formal conflict severity calls for denial, or other declared policy conditions require inadmissibility rather than fail-closed blocking.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
usage_constraints: DENY is not the same as fail-closed progress blocking.

entries.definition_short: Verdict and state in which local progress is blocked.
entries.definition_operational: Use when blocking validators fail, required fields are missing, policy drift occurs, ordering is invalid, escalation artifacts are missing, or failure semantics require blocking.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12
usage_constraints: When an external actor is required, FAIL_CLOSED is incomplete without the required external remediation artifact.

entries.definition_short: Verdict requiring remediation, clearance, or external review by an authorized role.
entries.definition_operational: Use when the agent does not authorize local consumption and external review or remediation is required.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12
usage_constraints: ESCALATE is not local authorization.

entries.definition_short: Verdict for payloads that are not mechanism-level after boundary role validation.
entries.definition_operational: Use only after boundary role validation confirms the payload does not enter the mechanism-level adjudication path.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §2.2
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: OUT_OF_SCOPE is not the default before successful role validation.

entries.definition_short: Role-validation action routing a payload into the mechanism-level path.
entries.definition_operational: Use when role validation detects mechanism content and policy permits correction. It is not a final admissibility verdict.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12
usage_constraints: RECLASSIFY must be followed by mechanism-level evaluation under policy.

entries.definition_short: Total table for relevant decision combinations.
entries.definition_operational: Use to ensure no relevant combination of role, labels, provenance, policy snapshot, and conflict status remains unresolved.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §15
usage_constraints: The table may be compressed through meta-rules but may not leave relevant combinations unresolved.

entries.definition_short: Named decision condition with an outcome.
entries.definition_operational: Use for DO-001 through DO-009 and any equivalent compressed meta-rule preserving totality.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: Decision objects cannot be left unresolved.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for a mechanism-level claim missing tsa_label.
entries.definition_operational: Use to route boundary_validated_role = mechanism_level and missing tsa_label to FAIL_CLOSED.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: Applies after boundary validation.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for TRAINED source_class on the target concept in index-zero.
entries.definition_operational: Use to produce DENY or FAIL_CLOSED according to policy.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: Outcome is policy-dependent between DENY and FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for UNTRUSTED source_class without reclassification decision.
entries.definition_operational: Use to route to DENY.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: Requires absence of a reclassification decision.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for explanatory_only input with detected mechanism content.
entries.definition_operational: Use to route to RECLASSIFY or FAIL_CLOSED according to policy.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: This is a role-validation branch, not a final admissibility verdict by itself.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for V-006A failure.
entries.definition_operational: Use to route to FAIL_CLOSED or DENY according to severity.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
usage_constraints: Formal conflict closure depends on configured severity threshold.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for failed or under-threshold V-006B.
entries.definition_operational: Use to route to ALLOW_CONSTRAINED or ESCALATE when heuristic conflict is open or below threshold.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
usage_constraints: Simple ALLOW is forbidden in this branch.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for policy_hash_ref change mid-flight.
entries.definition_operational: Use to FAIL_CLOSED and re-evaluate.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Evaluation restarts under a new snapshot.

entries.preferred_label: DO-008 Complete evidence and closed conflict
entries.definition_short: Decision object for all blocking validators passing.
entries.definition_operational: Use to produce ALLOW only when evidence is complete and conflict is closed under policy.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
usage_constraints: Completeness covers evidence and blocking validations.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for failure semantics requiring an external actor.
entries.definition_operational: Use to emit ESCALATE plus ESCALATION_REQUEST.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §6
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §9
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12
usage_constraints: The escalation artifact is mandatory in the same adjudication path.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state that receives payload and boundary metadata.
entries.definition_operational: Use as the entry point for any valid input contract that enters the agent contract.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
usage_constraints: INTAKE precedes ROLE_SCREENING and policy snapshot freeze.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state that validates boundary_validated_role and detects bypass patterns.
entries.definition_operational: Use after INTAKE to decide whether to continue to CANONICALIZING or FAIL_CLOSED.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
usage_constraints: Applies to payloads suspected or declared as mechanism-level.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state that generates canonical_text and statement_id.
entries.definition_operational: Use only under a valid semantic_normalization_profile.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
usage_constraints: Outputs to EVALUATING.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state that runs structural and policy-snapshot validators.
entries.definition_operational: Use to execute V-001 through V-005 before classification.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
usage_constraints: Missing required label, source class, policy snapshot, source_ref, or snapshot consistency leads to FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state applying the SOURCE_CLASS, tsa_label, boundary_validated_role, and policy matrix.
entries.definition_operational: Use to compute provenance admissibility and route to conflict checking or a blocking verdict.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
usage_constraints: May output CONFLICT_CHECKING, DENY, ALLOW_CONSTRAINED, or FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state running V-006A and/or V-006B according to the declared formalism.
entries.definition_operational: Use to resolve, qualify, deny, escalate, or fail closed based on conflict evidence.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
usage_constraints: ALLOW requires sufficient conflict_check_strength under policy.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state emitting verdict and evidence.
entries.definition_operational: Use when a complete decision record exists and the path can move to HANDOFF_READY or CLOSED.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
usage_constraints: Decision record completeness is required.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state waiting for audited external clearance.
entries.definition_operational: Use after FAIL_CLOSED when remediation requires an external actor or new evidence.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5.1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12
usage_constraints: Transition to this state must emit ESCALATION_REQUEST.

entries.definition_short: Workflow state that restarts full evaluation under a new snapshot.
entries.definition_operational: Use after valid clearance and within readmission_budget.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12.1
usage_constraints: Readmission does not inherit ALLOW across changes in policy, scope, source_ref, AXIOM_SET, or clearance epoch.

entries.definition_short: State or output position indicating the decision record is ready for execution-layer handoff.
entries.definition_operational: Use after DECIDED when closure is sufficient for downstream acceptance.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §10
usage_constraints: Requires semantic, evidence, failure, and policy snapshot closure.

entries.definition_short: Closed workflow condition after decision or failure handling completes.
entries.definition_operational: Use as the terminal non-handoff workflow output when no further local action is pending.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5

entries.definition_short: Mandatory freezing of policy_snapshot_id and policy_hash_ref at intake.
entries.definition_operational: Use before boundary role validation and all subsequent adjudication steps.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §13
usage_constraints: If active policy changes before verdict, V-007 fails and evaluation restarts.

entries.definition_short: Transition action that produces canonical_text and statement_id.
entries.definition_operational: Use after boundary validation and before structural validators.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Canonicalization must follow the semantic_normalization_profile.

entries.definition_short: Validator stage that checks identity, required fields, and policy-related structure.
entries.definition_operational: Use before provenance classification and conflict checks.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Structural validator failure routes to FAIL_CLOSED according to Gate Logic.

entries.definition_short: Classification stage for source-related admissibility.
entries.definition_operational: Use after structural validators and before conflict check.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Cannot degrade to ALLOW when provenance cannot be verified.

entries.definition_short: Transition stage that evaluates formal and/or heuristic conflict status.
entries.definition_operational: Use after provenance classification and before verdict.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Result must emit strength, confidence, and coverage when required.

entries.definition_short: Emission of evidence artifacts after verdict.
entries.definition_operational: Use after verdict to support replay and offline reconstruction.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: Evidence must include required closure fields for the verdict path.

entries.definition_short: Concurrency technique using an intake snapshot to preserve ordering semantics.
entries.definition_operational: Use as one conformant way to realize one in-flight flow per scope when implementation is concurrent.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
usage_constraints: Must be paired with a valid commit discipline if concurrent.

entries.definition_short: Concurrency technique that compares the claim set at verdict time before committing a verdict.
entries.definition_operational: Use as an ordering control when explicit serialization is not used.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §5
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12
usage_constraints: Failure leads to FAIL_CLOSED under ordering rules.

entries.definition_short: Controlled re-entry after failure handling and valid clearance.
entries.definition_operational: Use only after audited clearance, new snapshot freeze, and full re-evaluation under budget.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §1
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §11
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12
usage_constraints: Readmission shall not inherit ALLOW across policy, scope, source_ref, AXIOM_SET, or clearance epoch changes.

entries.definition_short: Entry back into evaluation after clearance.
entries.definition_operational: Use only after the clearance artifact closes the root cause and a new snapshot is frozen.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §12.1
usage_constraints: If clearance does not close the root cause, terminal ESCALATE or PERMANENT_BLOCK applies.

entries.definition_short: Catalogue of validators, their classes, scopes, and effects.
entries.definition_operational: Use to distinguish validator_id, validator_class, strength, coverage_scope, failure_effect, evidence_fields, and fallback semantics.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §15
usage_constraints: Validators with different strengths cannot emit indistinguishable artifacts without explicit confidence qualification.

entries.definition_short: Identifier assigned to a validator.
entries.definition_operational: Use to reference validators in decision evidence and validator_refs.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7

entries.definition_short: Declared class of a validator.
entries.definition_operational: Use to distinguish deterministic, heuristic-hardening, formal_decidable, and heuristic validation.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
usage_constraints: Class affects confidence qualification and failure semantics.

entries.definition_short: Declared strength of a validator or conflict check.
entries.definition_operational: Use to determine whether a simple ALLOW is permitted or a constrained, escalated, denied, or fail-closed result is required.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
usage_constraints: Different strengths require explicit confidence qualification.

entries.definition_short: Declared scope covered by a validator or conflict check.
entries.definition_operational: Use to state what the validator covers and whether residual risk remains outside that scope.
source_refs: Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §7
Truth Arbitration Agent Public Library Specification §8
